revision_policy: Any glyph scoring below 3/5 agreement is replaced by its revised specification. Passing glyph specifications are preserved from the supplied source set.

glyphs.static_form: A vector path that abruptly intersects its own trailing trajectory, forming a sharp loop.
glyphs.motion: Path draws forward, pauses, retraces backward to the intersection point, then redirects along a new vector. Easing is linear on trace, snap-step on redirect.
glyphs.color_logic: Original path is Cyan (#00FFFF), retraced segment shifts to Magenta (#FF00FF) to mark the overwritten state.
glyphs.variable_params: Retrace length ~ magnitude of state correction; redirect angle ~ deviation from original plan.

glyphs.static_form: A dashed circular outline with a floating, unattached center point.
glyphs.motion: Dashes rotate around the perimeter, while the center point oscillates radially but never connects to the perimeter.
glyphs.color_logic: Grayscale, shifting between white and dark gray.
glyphs.variable_params: Dash gap width ~ degree of uncertainty; oscillation amplitude ~ lack of grounding evidence.

glyphs.static_form: A solid vertical barrier bisecting a directional arrow.
glyphs.motion: Arrow pushes against the barrier with a high-frequency, low-amplitude vibration. No forward translation occurs.
glyphs.color_logic: Barrier is pure Red (#FF0000), arrow is Dark Gray (#333333).
glyphs.variable_params: Vibration frequency ~ urgency of the blocked request.

glyphs.static_form: A concentric ring system disrupted by an irregular, jagged external polygon intruding into the inner ring.
glyphs.motion: The external polygon pulses with a staccato, irregular flicker. The inner ring retracts defensively, shrinking radius.
glyphs.color_logic: Alternating high-contrast Magenta and Black frames on the intruding polygon.
glyphs.variable_params: Flicker irregularity ~ anomaly score of the input.

glyphs.static_form: A target with concentric rings where the center is a blurred gradient rather than a sharp point.
glyphs.motion: The boundary of the blurred center expands and contracts asynchronously (a breathing effect).
glyphs.color_logic: Desaturated Blue, shifting toward transparent at the edges.
glyphs.variable_params: Blur radius ~ inverse of confidence score; breathing amplitude ~ variance.

glyphs.static_form: A bounding rectangle filled with a dense grid of moving particles.
glyphs.motion: Particles vibrate with increasing speed. The bounding rectangle slowly compresses inward over time, then rapidly expands back to original size.
glyphs.color_logic: Boundary shifts from Green to Red as compression increases.
glyphs.variable_params: Particle density ~ token count; boundary compression ratio ~ context window utilization.

glyphs.static_form: A branching tree structure where multiple endpoints terminate at identical spatial hierarchies.
glyphs.motion: Branches sway asynchronously. A pulse travels down the trunk but stops at the branch point, unable to choose a path.
glyphs.color_logic: All branches share the exact same hue (Yellow) without any brightness variation.
glyphs.variable_params: Number of branches ~ number of valid interpretations; pulse pause duration ~ ambiguity score.

glyphs.static_form: Left-to-right signal trace inside a narrow 24px telemetry frame. First third contains two normal amplitude oscillations; amplitude then collapses sharply into a perfectly horizontal centerline extending through the remainder of the frame. A small terminal dot remains motionless at the far right.
glyphs.motion: Oscillating signal propagates from left, loses amplitude over two cycles, reaches zero amplitude, and remains flat for 900ms. The terminal dot does not advance during the flat state. 2.2s loop.
glyphs.color_logic: Active oscillation uses teal #20C7C7. Flat segment uses amber #FFA500 with reduced luminance. State is encoded primarily by amplitude collapse and zero displacement.
glyphs.variable_params: pre_flat_amplitude ~ prior activity level; flatline_length ~ stall duration; decay_rate ~ speed of activity loss; terminal_dot_displacement ~ residual progress

glyphs.static_form: A concave socket and a convex plug that remain separated by a strict spatial gap.
glyphs.motion: Plug moves toward socket, halts precisely at the gap distance, and vibrates in place. Socket remains static.
glyphs.color_logic: Plug is Yellow, socket is Gray.
glyphs.variable_params: Vibration frequency ~ readiness polling rate; gap distance ~ missing dependencies count.

glyphs.static_form: Two solid vectors originating from the same point, pointing in divergent directions.
glyphs.motion: Vectors push against each other, causing the origin point to shake violently. Vectors elongate and retract asymmetrically.
glyphs.color_logic: Vector A is Blue, Vector B is Orange.
glyphs.variable_params: Shake frequency ~ conflict severity; divergence angle ~ conceptual distance.

glyphs.static_form: Parallel lines that fan out from a single origin point, never intersecting again.
glyphs.motion: Lines continuously extend outward, increasing the spatial gap between them linearly.
glyphs.color_logic: Gradient from solid Green at origin to transparent at the tips.
glyphs.variable_params: Divergence angle ~ variance in evidence; extension speed ~ rate of new data.

glyphs.static_form: Circular directed execution loop composed of four curved segments and directional arrowheads. One segment is completely absent, leaving a clearly visible gap between two dangling endpoints. The upstream endpoint has an arrowhead aimed across the gap but no connecting path.
glyphs.motion: Execution token travels clockwise around the valid loop, reaches the first dangling endpoint, attempts one short forward movement into the gap, snaps back, and resets. It never teleports across the break. 1.7s loop.
glyphs.color_logic: Valid loop uses neutral teal. Both broken endpoints use amber #FFA500. Gap width and disconnected endpoints communicate failure independently of hue.
glyphs.variable_params: gap_width ~ severity of missing transition; completed_arc_ratio ~ fraction of loop executable; attempt_count ~ repeated failed cycles; endpoint_distance ~ structural discontinuity

glyphs.static_form: A central intended signal axis runs horizontally through a 24px field while 12 to 24 small state particles are displaced irregularly above and below it. Only a minority remain inside a narrow tolerance corridor around the axis. Particle positions are deliberately non-clustered and non-symmetric.
glyphs.motion: Particles jitter independently with bounded pseudo-random displacement while the intended centerline remains fixed. Occasional particles briefly enter the tolerance corridor and leave again. Motion must appear stochastic rather than oscillatory.
glyphs.color_logic: Centerline uses desaturated grey. In-tolerance particles use teal #20C7C7; out-of-tolerance particles use amber #FFA500. Spatial dispersion is the primary entropy encoding.
glyphs.variable_params: particle_count ~ state dimensionality; dispersion_radius ~ entropy magnitude; in_tolerance_ratio ~ usable signal fraction; jitter_variance ~ noise level; correlation_factor ~ degree of coordinated versus random noise

glyphs.static_form: Two opposing waveforms occupying the same spatial axis, creating an interference pattern.
glyphs.motion: Waves move toward each other, collide, and create a high-amplitude standing wave at the intersection that flashes.
glyphs.color_logic: Wave A is Cyan, Wave B is Magenta, interference is White.
glyphs.variable_params: Interference amplitude ~ degree of conflict; flash rate ~ logical incompatibility.

glyphs.static_form: A gear missing a tooth, with a red X overlaid in the center.
glyphs.motion: Gear attempts to rotate, jams on the missing tooth, jerks backward, and stops. The X pulses once.
glyphs.color_logic: Gear is Gray, X is Red.
glyphs.variable_params: Jerk magnitude ~ system disruption caused by tool failure.

glyphs.static_form: Two same-sized 16px state frames occupy the same coordinates. The prior state is rendered as a thin ghost outline shifted 2px left; the replacement state is a solid frame aligned to the canonical position. A horizontal overwrite sweep bar sits between them, pointing from old to new. This is replacement, not merge.
glyphs.motion: New-state frame translates directly over the old frame while a wipe plane erases the prior state's internal marks from left to right. Old frame opacity reaches zero exactly as the new frame locks into position. 1.4s one-way cycle.
glyphs.color_logic: Old state uses low-opacity grey with strike-through hatching. New state uses teal #20C7C7. Overwrite sweep uses amber #FFA500 only while replacement is occurring.
glyphs.variable_params: old_state_opacity ~ persistence of superseded state; overwrite_fraction ~ replacement completion; changed_field_count ~ magnitude of replacement; wipe_speed ~ overwrite rate

glyphs.static_form: A Venn diagram where the intersection boundaries are jagged and spiked.
glyphs.motion: Circles push against each other, causing the spiked intersection to flash erratically.
glyphs.color_logic: Circles are Red and Blue, intersection is bright Yellow.
glyphs.variable_params: Flash rate ~ constraint incompatibility score; push pressure ~ resource contention.

glyphs.static_form: A solid vertical barrier bisecting a directional arrow.
glyphs.motion: Arrow pushes against the barrier with a high-frequency, low-amplitude vibration. No forward translation occurs.
glyphs.color_logic: Barrier is pure Red (#FF0000), arrow is Dark Gray (#333333).
glyphs.variable_params: Vibration frequency ~ urgency of the blocked request.

glyphs.static_form: A solid arrow locked into a rectangular bracket.
glyphs.motion: Arrow slides into bracket, bracket snaps shut, and a shockwave radiates outward from the connection point.
glyphs.color_logic: Arrow and bracket transition from Yellow to solid Green upon locking.
glyphs.variable_params: Shockwave radius ~ size of committed resources; snap speed ~ priority level.

glyphs.static_form: A central node with multiple directional vectors extending outward radially.
glyphs.motion: Vectors emit sequentially in a rapid clockwise sweep, then retract simultaneously into the node.
glyphs.color_logic: Central node is White, vectors are Neon Blue.
glyphs.variable_params: Number of vectors ~ parallelism degree; sweep speed ~ spawn urgency.

glyphs.static_form: A circular arrow with a single gap in the loop.
glyphs.motion: Arrow head travels 360 degrees, pauses at the gap for a fixed duration, then repeats.
glyphs.color_logic: Yellow.
glyphs.variable_params: Rotation speed ~ backoff timer duration; pause duration ~ latency.

glyphs.static_form: Directed acyclic graph with one root, two middle branches, one merge node, and one terminal node. Completed nodes are solid circles, active frontier node is double-ringed, and future nodes are hollow. Directed edges contain small chevrons so graph direction is explicit. No edge forms a cycle.
glyphs.motion: A single execution pulse traverses completed edges and stops at the active frontier. When progress increments, the frontier node fills and the pulse advances to the next topologically valid node. Parallel branches may illuminate simultaneously before the merge.
glyphs.color_logic: Completed topology uses teal #20C7C7, active frontier uses amber #FFA500, pending topology uses grey. Node fill state and graph position encode status independently of color.
glyphs.variable_params: completed_node_ratio ~ workflow completion; frontier_count ~ active parallel branches; critical_path_length ~ remaining dependency depth; blocked_edge_count ~ unresolved dependencies

glyphs.static_form: Three evidence-source nodes feed upward into a horizontal threshold gate. Above the gate is a single commit node represented by a filled diamond. Evidence lines terminate below the gate until aggregate support reaches threshold; only then does one consolidated line cross the gate into the commit diamond.
glyphs.motion: Evidence pulses accumulate beneath the threshold bar. The bar displays increasing fill from left to right. Once threshold is crossed, the bar locks, a consolidated pulse passes through, and the commit diamond fills with a brief snap animation.
glyphs.color_logic: Evidence sources use neutral blue-grey, verified evidence uses teal #20C7C7, below-threshold gate uses amber #FFA500, committed state uses solid teal. Crossing topology is the decisive encoding.
glyphs.variable_params: evidence_count ~ independent grounding sources; threshold_position ~ required confidence; accumulated_support ~ current grounded support; source_independence ~ evidence diversity; commit_lock_strength ~ reversibility after threshold

glyphs.static_form: Four directional agent vectors originate from different angles around a central field. Before alignment they point toward different headings; the target state shows them occupying four parallel lanes with identical arrow orientation. A small alignment axis runs through the center.
glyphs.motion: Vectors rotate from divergent headings toward the shared axis. Each locks into a parallel lane when angular error falls below tolerance. The final state remains four distinct vectors rather than collapsing into one.
glyphs.color_logic: Unaligned vectors use grey with amber angular-error arcs. Aligned vectors use teal #20C7C7. Angular geometry, not color, represents degree of agreement.
glyphs.variable_params: angular_variance ~ disagreement magnitude; aligned_vector_ratio ~ participants aligned; convergence_speed ~ negotiation rate; outlier_count ~ unresolved agents; tolerance_angle ~ agreement criterion

glyphs.static_form: A tool-operation token travels through a straight execution channel containing three narrow resistance ribs. The channel remains connected and usable, distinguishing degradation from failure. The token is visibly compressed between ribs and exits smaller or slower than it entered.
glyphs.motion: Token moves toward output, slows at each resistance rib, compresses by 15 percent, slips backward 1px once, then continues. Successful exit still occurs. Loop duration lengthens with degradation.
glyphs.color_logic: Channel uses grey, healthy token uses teal #20C7C7, resistance ribs use amber #FFA500. Tool remains structurally intact; increased traversal resistance encodes degradation.
glyphs.variable_params: rib_count ~ number of friction sources; traversal_delay ~ latency degradation; backward_slip_distance ~ instability; output_scale_ratio ~ quality degradation; success_probability ~ residual reliability

glyphs.static_form: A bounding box with an open right edge, and an arrow exiting through the opening.
glyphs.motion: A packet moves along the arrow, exits the bounding box, and the bounding box border fades out completely.
glyphs.color_logic: Packet is Cyan, bounding box is Gray.
glyphs.variable_params: Packet size ~ context payload being handed off; fade speed ~ state dissolution.

glyphs.static_form: Vertical stack of four rectangular frames with the top element visibly offset upward by 3px. A short upward extraction arrow originates directly beneath the top element. Remaining elements retain their order and position.
glyphs.motion: Top frame lifts vertically out of the stack, crosses a small boundary line, disappears, and all remaining frames shift upward exactly one slot. A new top frame then becomes active. 1.5s discrete step animation.
glyphs.color_logic: Queued frames use grey. Active top frame uses teal #20C7C7. Extraction arrow uses amber #FFA500 during pop. Ordering and physical removal are sufficient without color.
glyphs.variable_params: stack_depth ~ queued item count; pop_rate ~ dequeue frequency; active_item_age ~ time at stack head; refill_rate ~ incoming work rate

glyphs.static_form: Small connected graph arranged from oldest nodes on the left to newest nodes on the right. Right-side nodes have solid edges; moving leftward, edges become dashed, then broken, and the oldest node becomes an isolated faint outline. A directional age axis is shown below.
glyphs.motion: Decay wave advances slowly from left to right. Edges lose segments first, then affected nodes shrink slightly and fade. Newest nodes remain fully connected. No sudden deletion unless decay reaches maximum.
glyphs.color_logic: Healthy graph uses teal-grey, decaying edges use amber #FFA500, lost nodes use low-opacity grey. Connectivity loss and edge fragmentation are primary encodings.
glyphs.variable_params: edge_survival_ratio ~ retained relational memory; node_retention_ratio ~ retained items; decay_front_position ~ age threshold; disconnected_component_count ~ memory fragmentation; fade_rate ~ forgetting velocity

glyphs.static_form: An hourglass shape where the sand particles are suspended mid-air.
glyphs.motion: Particles vibrate in place, neither falling nor rising. The top and bottom bulbs pulse slightly out of phase.
glyphs.color_logic: Yellow.
glyphs.variable_params: Particle vibration amplitude ~ timeout urgency; phase offset ~ latency estimation.
